title: Declaration Base Information Package — upu
description: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

acceptance.description: Date and time of acceptance of a document in accordance with governmental legislation.

function.description: Code specifying the function of a document.

type.description: Code specifying the name of a document.
type.x-wco-code-list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User codes

grossWeight.description: Weight of goods including packing but excluding carrier's equipment.

items.description: Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.

identification.description: Identification of a document providing additional information.

type.description: Code specifying the type of an additional document.
type.x-wco-code-list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User codes

items.description: Details related to additional documents as part of a declaration or as part of a response.

currencyType.description: Code specifying a monetary unit or currency.

items.description: Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

dutyRegime.description: Code specifying a type of duty regime.
dutyRegime.x-wco-code-list: UN/EDIFACT code list 9213 OR User codes

items.description:
Details related to calculation of one instance of one duty, one tax, and/or one fee. 
Comment: Each instance of this class is to be used for a single occurrence of duty, tax or fee.

transactionNature.description: Code specifying the nature of a transaction associated with a shipment.
transactionNature.x-wco-code-list:
WCO code + User codes.
Remark:
* First digit indicates WCO code table value;
* Second digit can be used as additional User code to further define first digit

statementAmount.description: Amount expressed on the additional statement.

items.description: Details related to the special request from declarant to government to take or not to take action.

identification.description: Identification of a party to which goods are consigned.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

items.description: Details related to the party to which goods are consigned.

type.description: Code specifying means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at arrival.

items.description: Details related to the means of transport at arrival.

arrival.description: Date and time of arrival (actual or scheduled) of the means of transport at the first port (e.g. seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station).

items.description: Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

routingCountry.description: Code specifying the country through which goods or passengers are routed between the country of original departure and final destination.

items.description: Details related to the itinerary of the means of transport.

arrival.description: Date and time of arrival at port or airport with the intent to unload.

items.description: Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignment) are unloaded from the active means of transport having been used for their carriage.
Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.

name.description: Name of the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering transport.

country.description: Code specifying the name of the country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.

line.description: Specification of the postal delivery point such as street and number or post office box.

postcode.description: Identification of the postal zone or address.

items.description: Details related to an address.
Details related to the party which, by contract with a carrier, consigns or sends goods with the carrier, or has them conveyed by him.

exitToEntryCharge.description: Amount indicating the total cost of freight, insurance and all other costs and expenses from the foreign exit location to the entry location.

freightCharge.description: Amount indicating the total costs incurred by the shipper in moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another under the terms of the contract of carriage. In addition to transport costs, this may include such elements as packing, documentation, loading, unloading, and insurance (i.e., to the extent that they relate to the freight cost).

items.description: Details related to valuation applying to the shipment.

name.description: Name of the party to which goods are to be delivered.

country.description: Code specifying the name of the country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.

line.description: Specification of the postal delivery point such as street and number or post office box.

postcode.description: Identification of the postal zone or address.

items.description: Details related to an address.
Details related to the party to which goods are to be delivered.

country.description: Code specifying  the country from which the goods are originally exported without any commercial transaction taken place in intermediate countries.

items.description: Details related to the export country.

customsValue.description: Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment which are subject to the same customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

sequence.description: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

description.description: Description of the nature of a goods item sufficient to identify it for cross-border regulatory purposes such as customs, phytosanitary, statistical or transport.

identification.description: Identification of the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.

items.description: Details related to the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.

itemCharge.description: Amount due for each chargeable item of goods or services.

items.description: Details related to the line item of an invoice.
Details related to the properties of the goods.

netNetWeight.description: Weight of the goods themselves without any packing.

items.description: Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.

country.description: Code specifying the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.

items.description: Details related to the origin of the goods.

marksNumbers.description: Marks and or numbers on a transport unit or package.

quantity.description: Quantity specifying the number of individual items packaged in such a way that they cannot be divided without first undoing the packing.

type.description: Code specifying the type of package of an item.

items.description: Details related to packaging.
Details related to the goods item as declared to Government Agency.

name.description: Name of the party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who is in possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.

identification.description: Identification of a party who makes, or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes, an import declaration. This may include a person who has possession of the goods or to whom the goods are consigned.
identification.x-wco-code-list: International codes (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User codes

role.description: Code specifying the role of a party.

type.description: Code specifying the type of communication address.

items.description: Details related to communication including number and number type.
Details related to the party who makes - or on whose behalf a customs clearing agent or other authorized person makes - an import declaration.
Details related to the movement and the handling of goods shipped together on one or more means of transport between original consignor and final consignee.

traderAssignedReference.description: Identification of the number assigned by a declarant such as a trader reference or a carrier reference.

items.description: Details related to the Unique Trader Reference such as Unique Consignment Reference (UCR).
